hero.title: The plastic that returns to nature
hero.tagline: Same product. Same performance. A fraction of the footprint.
hero.body: Urinal screens cannot be recycled: through constant contact with urine they become biologically contaminated. Their only disposal routes are therefore incineration or landfill. In landfill, conventional plastic remains for centuries. Our products are manufactured with the Eco One additive, which allows the material to biodegrade.

problem.title: Why ordinary plastic is a problem
problem.body: Ordinary plastic products are engineered to last. Without a biodegradation additive, a plastic product sent to landfill can remain there for <bold>300 to 1,000 years</bold>; foam “Crocs-style” clogs are a familiar example of plastic that is <bold>not biodegradable</bold>. Our products are made from the same kind of durable plastic (EVA) — but with one decisive difference: the Eco One additive.
problem.chartAlt: Products without Eco One compared with ëkcos products containing the additive
problem.chartCaption: Products without Eco One compared with ëkcos products containing the additive.

chart.ariaLabel: Comparison of years to break down in landfill
chart.withoutDetail: Without a biodegradation additive, conventional plastic can remain in landfill for centuries.
chart.withDetail: With the Eco One additive, independent testing shows ~93% biodegradation in about 3.5 years, and up to 99% within five years.
chart.caption: Products without Eco One compared with ëkcos products containing the additive.

solution.title: Our solution: The Eco One additive
solution.body1: During manufacturing we incorporate approximately <bold>1% of Eco One</bold>, an organic additive dosed in the same way as a colorant. It does not affect the product’s strength, appearance or performance.
solution.body2: In a biologically active landfill, naturally occurring microorganisms break down the treated plastic through enzymatic activity, converting it into biogas (<bold>methane</bold>, which modern landfill sites capture for energy recovery), carbon dioxide and humus.
solution.body3: Because the product ultimately breaks down into humus, it returns organic matter to the landfill and helps accelerate the biochemical processes already at work there. The product therefore contributes <bold>not only during its service life, but also after it</bold>.

testing.title: Independent testing
testing.body: The product was tested by an independent laboratory to the international standards <bold>ASTM D5511 and ISO 15985</bold>, comparing the same product with and without the Eco One additive. With Eco One, it reached <bold>93.31% biodegradation within approximately 3.5 years, and up to 99% within five years</bold>; without Eco One, the product showed no measurable biodegradation.

barChart.ariaLabel: Biodegradation at approximately 3.5 years with and without Eco One
barChart.withDetail: 93.31% biodegradation measured in an independent ASTM D5511 / ISO 15985 lab test after about 3.5 years.
barChart.withoutDetail: The same product without Eco One showed no measurable biodegradation over the same test period.
barChart.subtitle: Same product · same lab test (ASTM D5511 / ISO 15985) · ~3.5 years

timelineChart.ariaLabel: Biodegradation over five years with and without Eco One
timelineChart.caption: Biodegradation with and without the Eco One additive. Values beyond 3.5 years are projected from the measured trend.

closing.title: ëkcos biodegradable products
closing.body: Our washroom products are manufactured with the Eco One additive and are up to 99% biodegradable, with performance identical to products without it and in many ways surpasses them.

ecoOne.footnote: Data source: independent biodegradation test per ASTM D5511-02 and ISO 15985:2014 (Instituto Politécnico Nacional, Mexico City) — ëkcos product with 1% Eco One additive: 93.31% biodegradation over 1,288 days (≈3.5 years); the same product without the additive: 0%. Biodegradation beyond the test period (up to 99% within ~5 years) is projected from the measured trend. Persistence figures for conventional plastics (≈300–1,000 years) are widely cited industry estimates. The Eco One® additive is manufactured and certified by EcoLogic, LLC.

hero.title: Private Label Program
hero.lead: Sell our products under your own brand
hero.body: Grow your business with your own line of products. Our Private Label Program lets distributors add proven, high-performing washroom products to their portfolio and sell them under their own brand — with no development or tooling of your own. All we need is your logo; we take care of the rest.

0.title: Proven solutions
0.body: Every product is the result of intensive development and engineered for optimal, reliable performance — a range you can put your name on with confidence.

1.title: Easy customization
1.body: We only need your logo to provide you with a series of products that you can sell under your own brand.

2.title: Premium support
2.body: We guide you through the whole process, so you can expand your brand and your sales.

ways.title: Two ways to brand the products

print.title: Printed branding
print.body: Your logo printed directly onto the product.

cutout.title: Logo cut-out
cutout.body: Your logo integrated into the material itself as a unique cut-out — a distinctive, premium finish that no other manufacturer offers, and a strong differentiator for your range.

packaging.title: Packaging & labels
packaging.body: Add your logo, company details, product names and descriptions, EAN codes and more to boxes, master cases or individual product bags — retail-ready under your own brand.

mix.title: Colour & fragrance
mix.body: Offer your own signature combination of colour and scent from our range.

items.0: The minimum order quantity depends on the specific product you choose.
items.1: A one-time set-up fee applies for each product you wish to brand — it covers the tooling and preparation needed to reproduce your branding.
items.2: All branded products are made to order, to your specification.
items.3: We share the exact minimum quantities, pricing and lead times together with your quote, once we understand your specific requirements.
